focus: Q3 — measured purpose retention in the real packet corpus: handovers, continuity saves and phase-parent to child drift
noveltyJustification: All 8 findings are new: the first corpus-scale measurement of purpose presence (3294 spec.md, 97 handovers, all implementation-summary.md) and of phase-child lexical drift.
keyQuestions: In real packets under `specs/` that have a `handover.md` or several continuity saves, is the purpose restated, shortened or absent? Do phase children restate the parent's purpose or drift from it?
answeredQuestions: In real packets under `specs/` that have a `handover.md` or several continuity saves, is the purpose restated, shortened or absent? Do phase children restate the parent's purpose or drift from it?
ruledOut: handovers in practice restating the purpose because the template has room
continuity saves accumulating purpose over repeated writes
sourcesQueried: rg over specs/**/implementation-summary.md for continuity purpose keys (0 hits)

graphEvents.label: Purpose retention in real packets and phase children
0 of 97 handovers has a Purpose heading

16 of 65 child purposes share parent words

label: Purpose is authored at spec level and usually filled: of 3294 live spec.md files, 3211 carry the problem anchor, 2943 have filled Purpose text (89.3%), 22 keep a placeholder and 246 have an empty Purpose subsection.

handover.md carries no purpose field in practice: 0 of 97 handover files has a Purpose heading; 22 contain a purpose/problem/objective string incidentally (checklist pointer to spec.md, a trap note, a frontmatter description).
Exactly one of 97 handovers restates an objective and it lives outside any schema field as an author-added '**Objective:**' bullet, which the resume parser does not read.

Continuity state never carries purpose: a grep for a purpose/goal/objective/problem key at continuity indentation across every implementation-summary.md in specs/ returned 0 hits, absence by construction given the six-field record.
68 of the 97 handover packets also carry implementation-summary.md, so the several-continuity-saves case is common and both successor surfaces are purpose-free.

Phase children drift from the parent purpose: on the largest live phase parent (69 numbered children, 65 with purpose text) only 16 share >=3 significant words with the parent's 481-character purpose; children 001 and 002 share zero.

The parent's purpose is a container purpose and is already stale: it describes holding 'the thirty-eight packets as phases' while the folder holds 69 numbered children, so a child that restated it would inherit a container statement rather than a user need.
The one child that echoes the parent is the one whose subject is parent documentation, sharing 21 significant words; echo tracks subject matter, not inheritance.
